title: Requests and approvals
summary: Employees submit expense, purchase and leave requests. Approvers decide in order; finance records expense payouts. Every request keeps a decision history.

entryPoints.summary: Sign in with an invited account.
Submit and track requests within your role.
Invite people, edit lists and fields, routes and leave allowances.
Request a reset when email is enabled.
Choose a password using an emailed reset link.

owner.summary: Invites all roles, edits settings and sees every request.

employee.summary: Submits and sees only their own requests.

approver.summary: Decides routed requests in order and can submit their own.

finance.summary: Sees approved expenses, records payouts and exports.

visitor.summary: Sees sign-in, invite and password reset only.

journeys.summary: Opens owner settings with a one-time pass.
Invites an employee with a single-use link.
Adds and removes an unused category.
Creates a request with a server-calculated total.
Signed-out visitors see sign-in and no requests.
Explains how password reset depends on email.
Uploads and downloads a private receipt through the file module.
Sends submitted, needs-your-approval and decided notices through the email module.
Submits an over-threshold expense, two approvers decide in order and finance records payout.

notIncluded: Email and receipts need their platform modules, off by default. The inviter can share one-time links when email is unavailable.
One company and one currency per app; no currency conversion, tax or payroll calculation.
Finance records a payout already made elsewhere; this app does not move money.
Leave uses whole days per calendar year; no half days, carry-over or holiday calendar.
No deleting requests or changing a final decision. Returned requests restart their approval route and keep previous rounds.
No public signup or signed-in password change for invited people.
Queued emails retry on request activity or the owner retry button, not a background schedule.
Employee CSV imports at most fifty email addresses as invitations; they become accounts when accepted.
Live deployment needs the platform live database.
